messages:
customer_jake: Hi, I accepted an invite to Acme Org (org_id: org_789) but when I open Projects I can't access the 'payroll' project settings — UI greys out and any API call I try returns 403. Need access to change billing mapping urgently.
mike_support: Sorry about that, we'll help. Can you confirm the email you used for the invite and the project id? Also does your IdP show you as Active and assigned to any groups?
customer_jake: Email is jake@acme.com. Project id is proj_payroll_42. Okta shows me in group "payroll-engineers" and the user is Active.
elena_devex: Thanks. Did you join via the IdP invite (SSO/SCIM) or did someone send a console invite? If IdP/SCIM we need to check group->role mapping.
mike_support: Quick repro steps for our side: 1) log into console as user 2) click Projects -> open 'payroll' 3) click Settings -> observe "You don't have permission to view this page (403)". Customer, any exact console toast text or a curl you ran?
customer_jake: Console toast: "You don't have permission to view this page (403)". I ran:

curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION" https://console.redwood.com/api/v1/projects/proj_payroll_42/settings

Response body:  {"error":"forbidden","message":"user lacks role: project_admin"}

My SSO session shows valid token.
rahul_sre: Can you run: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION" https://console.redwood.com/api/v1/account/me and paste the roles field? That'll show what our system currently thinks your roles are.
customer_jake: Returned: {"id":"user_123","email":"jake@acme.com","roles":["viewer"],"org_roles":["member"],"scim_groups":["payroll-engineers"]}
elena_devex: Ok. SCIM group looks right but mapping may have changed — we recently adjusted the regex that maps groups ending in "-engineers" to project_admin. If the mapping fails the user ends up with viewer only.
okta_sync_bot: SCIM PROVISION: user user_123 added to group "payroll-engineers" for org org_789 at 1725009880. Mapping evaluation: rule "project-by-group-v2" -> MATCH: false.
mike_support: That log suggests the group was added but mapping evaluation returned false. Rahul, can you check the identity mapping logs (/admin/identity/mapping-events) and confirm why the rule returned false for that group name?
rahul_sre: Checking logs now. I see the rule was updated last deploy — the capturing regex expects group names like "project-payroll-engineers" now. The plain "payroll-engineers" doesn't match, so mapping returned null. I'll trigger a one-off resync for Acme org and run a mapping preview.
rahul_sre: Triggered resync at 1725009882. Mapping preview output: group "payroll-engineers" -> proposed role: project_admin (after fallback rule). Will attempt to provision.
okta_sync_bot: IDENTITY SYNC: provisioning attempt for user_123 -> assign role project_admin to project proj_payroll_42 : queued
customer_jake: I logged out and back in after that but still getting 403.
mike_support: Could be session cache TTL — we cache role assertions for ~15m. Rahul, can you flush session cache for this user?
rahul_sre: Flushed session cache for user_123 and re-provisioned mapping at 1725009930.
okta_sync_bot: SESSION CACHE: Flushed sessions for user_123 at 1725009930.
customer_jake: Tried again (incognito window). Project settings open now, I can see the admin controls. Thank you :tada:
mike_support: Great — closing the active support ticket once you confirm. We'll also schedule a backfill for orgs with "-engineers" groups and roll a fix for the mapping regex so this doesn't recur. Follow-up ticket: SUP-4327 opened and assigned to idp-team.
elena_devex: Action items: 1) revert/adjust regex in mapping rules in staging 2) run immediate backfill for org_789+similar 3) add a console banner when SSO mapping fails (so users know why they see reduced perms). I'll create a GH issue and link to SUP-4327.
customer_jake: Really appreciate the fast response :thumbsup:
